approaches.name: digital platforms for youth employment and entrepreneurship services
approaches.description: The project uses online application, e-learning, job intermediation and MIS platforms, plus possible machine-learning growth predictors, to select, train and place youth. Practices: Online application platform with entrepreneurial aptitude test for preselection; Enhanced INEFOP MIS tracking implementation progress and beneficiaries; E-learning platform delivering employability training; INEFOP portal for youth job placement intermediation; INEFOP e-learning platform for online skills training; Machine-learning predictors of firm growth to complement business plan analysis.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: digital aptitude test screens grant applicants - cue: 'Digital tools' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: Digital tools to be adopted in this phase will include a website and IT platform to manage receipt of applications through an online questionnaire and development or adoption of a simple test measuring entrepreneurial aptitude to facilitate preselection.

extra_evidence.text: INEFOP will enhance its computerized Management Information System (MIS) to incorporate additional features that track implementation progress.
It will prepare semiannual reports on project implementation, utilizing data from an information platform that integrates details on activities and beneficiaries from the participating entities.
